title: Bootstrap a grid-based location estimate
description: You refine a likelihood search and repeat it on resampled observations.

steps.description: You create candidate locations across a percentile-based interval. The helper scores each candidate with cauchy_loglik and selects the largest score.
You create a narrower grid around the selected location and repeat the likelihood comparison. The returned estimate comes from this refined grid.

steps.question: Can a bootstrap sample contain the same observation more than once?
steps.answer: Yes. rng.choice uses replace=True and draws a sample with the original length.

steps.description: You collect estimates from the resamples and use their percentiles for interval endpoints. The print requests the interval, but the supplied trace excerpt contains no final output.
